scope: Direct external tools and runtimes used or evaluated by repository privacy controls; transitive packages remain governed by uv.lock and dependency audits.

tools.name: Microsoft Presidio Analyzer
tools.role: Structured identifier and targeted OCR-text analysis
tools.output_policy: Matched values suppressed; no report upload

tools.name: spaCy en_core_web_sm
tools.output_policy: Runs in-process; model output is reduced by the Presidio wrapper

tools.name: HoundDog Privacy Code Scanner
tools.version_source: Reviewed local standalone release; receipt hashes version output
tools.role: Sensitive-value dataflow into logging, files, APIs, and storage
tools.output_policy: Raw JSON is private and ephemeral; only counts/status are printed

tools.name: dicom-phi-scan
tools.role: DICOM header and pixel-PHI secondary scan
tools.output_policy: Raw report is private and ephemeral; only counts/status are printed

tools.name: Tesseract OCR
tools.role: OCR of changed images and privately rendered document pages
tools.output_policy: OCR text exists only in process/private temporary storage

tools.name: Poppler pdftoppm
tools.role: Rasterize bounded PDF pages for local OCR
tools.output_policy: Rendered pages stay in private temporary storage and are deleted

tools.name: Pillow
tools.role: Normalize extracted images to PNG for OCR
tools.output_policy: Converted images stay in private temporary storage

tools.name: pypdf
tools.role: Bounded PDF validation/page counting and text/metadata admission checks
tools.output_policy: Extracted content is scanned in-process and values are suppressed

tools.name: Semgrep
tools.role: Blocking project privacy and general SAST rules
tools.output_policy: Metrics disabled; project wrapper emits value-safe findings

tools.name: SonarQube Community Build
tools.version_source: Loopback Docker server API; local image ID recorded outside Git
tools.role: Optional code-quality and security second opinion
tools.output_policy: Raw scanner log is ephemeral; only status/digests are retained under .git

tools.name: SonarScanner CLI
tools.role: Submit analysis to the loopback SonarQube server
tools.output_policy: Console output is captured privately and deleted after safe classification

tools.name: ExifTool
tools.role: Candidate secondary metadata inventory for images, PDF, Office, and DICOM
tools.output_policy: Do not run directly in shared logs; future wrapper must suppress values and paths
